newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Philippines' Smart plans advanced telecom services.
newsitem.headline: Philippines' Smart plans advanced telecom services.

text.p: Smart Communications Inc of the Philippines said on Wednesday it had signed a memorandum of agreement with affiliate Nippon Telegraph and Telephone Corp (NTT) of Japan to jointly invest in advanced telecommunications services.

"The two firms have agreed to explore new business opportunities in providing such services and facilities as managed bandwidth, packet-switching, Internet and Open Computer Network," Smart said in a statement.
"This will rapidly enhance Smart's capability to offer the world's most modern telecoms services to its customers," Smart chairman Manuel Pangilinan said.
"our long-term goal is to make Smart a fully-integrated telecoms service provider," he added.
Smart is a joint venture between Metro Pacific Corp, its parent First Pacific Co Ltd and NTT.
